title: Works ok
text: Works ok. I wanted to wait a few days to see how this worked. Ok it has been 1 week since I put sliced cucumbers and green peppers in this. I also put in a damp paper towel as I always do with veggies. After 3 days the cukes began to have a slimy feel to them but the peppers were good. I wiped out all of the moisture and took the paper towel out and added slices of zucchini. After 2 more days peppers were still crisp and slices of zucchini were ok but the interesting thing is that there is a big moisture build up inside. Each day when I open it, I have to wipe it all out.😒 . When I first started to use this I couldnt figure out how to let the air out because all of the other ones I used, you just push the button down to release the air. So I went back to the instructions and read them more carefully. You must push the yellow plug to the side to release air. The pump you use to pump the air out is very easy to use. Its like a giant plastic syringe. As you pump, it begins to get harder each time because you are sucking out the air. This container is very thick and seals very tight. It has a rubber seal on the top to help keep the air out.
